text: If we start requiring background checks for private gun sales, it is only a matter of time before the government creates a national firearms registry. Once they have a registry, confiscation is inevitable. History has shown us exactly where this leads: an unarmed population at the mercy of a tyrannical state. What starts as a reasonable-sounding regulation ends with the complete erosion of your Second Amendment rights.
